name: Switch to 3D Command Center view

actions.comment: Was a bare `goto /agents-flow`. Unauthenticated that redirects to /login (401 on the first /api call) or /setup, so the '3D' toggle was never on screen to click.

expect: A 3D visualization is visible with Three.js rendered content
The 3D button in the toggle is active/highlighted
Agent pods or 3D objects are visible in the scene
